script: Spread and total were not saved, so this is form-only: neither run game can control CLE@NYJ — Quinshon Judkins has 144 yards on 47 carries (3.06 YPC) with Deshaun Watson also taking 19 rushes for 95, while Breece Hall has 61 yards on 29 carries (2.10 YPC) and Braelon Allen 80 on 23. Both passing games are the form driver, so it projects pass-leaning rather than a grind, with NYJ's 37% blitz the only tempo wrinkle and CLE blitzing just 24%.
who_goes_off: Harold Fannin Jr. should go off for CLE: 20 targets, 132 yards and 130 air yards over the last three (6.5 aDOT) into the NYJ middle that has allowed 9.26 YPA on 35 throws. Isaiah Williams should go off for NYJ: 11 targets for 128 yards (11.6 per target) and 77 air yards against a CLE defense that has allowed 9.47 YPA in the middle and 15 passes of 20+ on 157 attempts. Denzel Boston's 225 yards and 269 air yards are the loudest CLE form, but that 14.2 aDOT is the outside vertical game NYJ has squeezed (5.83 left, 5.06 right, only 9 explosives on 136 throws), so he is not the edge.
weak_spot: NYJ's hole is the middle, not the perimeter: 9.26 YPA on 35 middle attempts versus 5.83 on 42 left and 5.06 on 50 right, with only 9 gains of 20+ on 136 pass attempts — so the matchup is LBs, nickel and safeties, which is Fannin's 20-target role, not Boston's deep outside usage. CLE's hole is the same lane plus explosives: 9.47 YPA on 30 middle attempts versus 6.19 left and 6.69 right, 15 passes of 20+ on 157 attempts, and a run front at 4.67 YPC with 15 runs of 10+.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for CLE@NYJ, so there is no absence to reprice — Judkins (47 carries) and Hall (29 carries) both still show as the lead rushers, and Jerry Jeudy's 4 targets for 36 yards over three games is a usage fact, not an injury inference.
qb_vs_blitz: CLE's QB is flat versus pressure at 0.14 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=51) against 0.15 with no blitz, so NYJ's 37% blitz does not downgrade Fannin or K.Concepcion (23 targets, 101 yards). The NYJ QB is only a tick worse into the blitz, 0.12 EPA (n=35) versus 0.14 clean, and CLE blitzes just 24%, so Garrett Wilson (25 targets, 191 yards) and Isaiah Williams are not blitz-dependent.

picks.why: Fannin has 132 yards on 20 targets over three games, a 44.0 per-game pace against a 35.0 line, at 6.5 aDOT into the NYJ middle that allowed 9.26 YPA on 35 attempts, and CLE QB EPA stays 0.14 vs NYJ's 37% blitz.

Williams has 128 yards on 11 targets, a 42.7 per-game pace versus a 22.5 line, at 11.6 yards per target with 77 air yards, into CLE's 9.47 middle YPA on 30 attempts and 15 passes of 20+ on 157 attempts.
